planets.name: TOI-178 f
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-178 with a 15.2-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-178 f was found in 2021 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 6 planets known around TOI-178. Its orbit and size follow Leleu et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
